_metadata.description: Track which scenarios have adopted which components, and compute drift status on refresh.

requirements.title: Link or eject an adoption from the CLI
requirements.description: The governed adoption surface records a version-pinned `mode=linked` package dependency through `react-component-library adoptions link`. A deliberate source materialization uses `adoptions eject` and requires a non-empty reason, recording `mode=ejected` and `fork_reason`. Component_id is a soft FK (no SQL constraint) per per-domain rule.

validation.notes: Repository test, handler test, CLI smoke test all cover the create path.

requirements.title: Refresh computes drift status per adoption record
requirements.description: `POST /api/v1/adoptions/refresh` (and `... adoptions refresh`) reads each record, fetches the current library version of the component and the byte content at `adopted_path`, and sets `status` ∈ {current, behind, modified, unknown}: `current` if adopted_version == library version AND adopted bytes match library bytes; `behind` if adopted_version < library version AND adopted bytes still match the adopted_version snapshot; `modified` if adopted bytes diverge from any known version; `unknown` if adopted_path is missing.

validation.notes: Service test seeds a fake target scenario tree, varies version/bytes for each status, and asserts the computed status.

requirements.title: UI adoptions dashboard lists records with status badges
requirements.description: Adoptions page shows a table: component name, target scenario, adopted version, adopted path, status (color-coded badge), last refreshed timestamp. A refresh button triggers the API refresh and re-fetches.

validation.notes: Component test renders the page against fixture data covering each status; a11y test ensures status conveys non-color information.

requirements.title: Ejection is explicit and provenance-safe
requirements.description: Eject compares the selected source and target, requires a non-empty reason, records source and snapshot hashes plus provenance, and reports direct import sites. Linked adoption never overwrites consumer source.

validation.notes: internal/adoptions service test proves divergence confirmation, stamped provenance, and import-site reporting.

requirements.title: Explainable adoption suggestions
requirements.description: SuggestAdoptions joins InventoryService.ScanScenario, the component registry, design-style fit, dependency compatibility, and adoption records. It excludes already adopted pairs and returns every ranking reason.

validation.notes: Handler identity-match test plus live CLI probes across web-console and 20 real scenario candidates.
